stories.title: Generate Microlearning Module Breakdown for All CoCus
stories.description: Analyze each CoCu's content and learning outcomes, break into 10-15 minute self-contained microlearning units with explicit learning objectives. Validate that each unit maps to at least one outcome and sequencing follows Bloom's progression.
acceptanceCriteria: Script reads all 20 content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md files and extracts learning outcomes from tables/sections
Generates output/microlearning_modules.json with structure {cocu_name, modules: [{title, duration_minutes, learning_outcomes: [], bloom_level}]}
Validates module duration 10-15 min; flags outliers >20 min for manual review; ensures lower-order skills precede higher-order

stories.title: Create CoCu Learning Outcome Coverage Validator
stories.description: Implement automated verification that every learning outcome in each CoCu is actively covered by both a practical exercise AND an assessment item. Generate detailed gap report identifying orphaned/unreferenced outcomes with remediation path.
acceptanceCriteria: Script parses learning outcomes from all 20 CoCu markdown files (extract from tables/sections); regex match against Practical Exercises and Assessment Criteria sections

Flags outcomes without at least one practical exercise and one assessment reference; output output/outcome_coverage_report.json with {total_outcomes, coverage_percent, gaps: [{outcome_text, missing_practical_exercise, missing_assessment}]}
Exit code 0 if coverage ≥95%, exit code 1 if <95%; provides file:line references for all gaps

stories.title: Generate Cognitive Load Analysis for Learning Outcome Descriptions
stories.description: Analyze clarity, readability, and specificity of every learning outcome description across all CoCus. Flag vague language, overly complex descriptions, and unmeasurable objectives. Suggest Bloom's-aligned action verb replacements.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads all learning outcomes; calculates Flesch-Kincaid grade level per outcome; flags grade >12
Detects vague verbs ('understand', 'know', 'appreciate') and suggests Bloom's 2023 taxonomy verbs (Remember→Create) with contextual fit
Outputs output/cognitive_load_analysis.json with {outcomes_analyzed, grade_level_issues: [{outcome, flesch_kincaid, suggestion}], vague_verbs: [{outcome, current_verb, suggested_verb}]}

stories.title: Build Cross-CoCu Competency Search Index for Curriculum Mapping
stories.description: Extract all unique competencies/skills across all 20 CoCus; deduplicate using semantic similarity (0.80 threshold); create searchable JSON index showing which CoCus teach each competency and at what Bloom's level. Enable rapid curriculum-wide searches.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses learning outcomes, work activities, and key terms from all 20 CoCu markdown files; extracts 200+ unique competency phrases
Deduplicates related competencies using sentence-transformers semantic similarity; groups at ≥0.80 threshold
Outputs output/competency_index.json with structure {competencies: [{name, appears_in: [{cocu_name, level: 'L3'|'L4'|'L5', bloom_level: 'Remember'|...|'Create'}]}]}

stories.title: Generate 4-Level Performance Evidence Rubrics for All Learning Outcomes
stories.description: Create detailed, NOSS-aligned rubrics for every learning outcome across all 20 CoCus showing observable evidence at 4 performance levels (Developing/Proficient/Advanced/Expert). Output as Excel workbook with formative and summative assessment descriptors.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads all learning outcomes; generates Excel workbook with separate tab per CoCu; validates 20+ outcomes per L3 CoCu, 15+ per L4, 15+ per L5
Each outcome tab has 4 rows (one per level) with: performance descriptor, observable evidence, example work product, and point allocation
Output file output/evidence_rubrics.xlsx; validates Bloom's cognitive level matches to performance expectations (Create-level outcomes require synthesis/evaluation evidence)

stories.title: Create Workplace Integration Scenarios for L5 Capstone Competencies
stories.description: For each of 7 L5 CoCus, generate 2-3 complex, realistic workplace scenarios requiring integration of 3+ learning outcomes plus cross-disciplinary problem-solving. Align to MTEM/BNM/SIRIM industry standards and current Malaysian IT workplace contexts.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads all 7 L5 CoCu files from content/IT-020-5/*.md; generates markdown file content/IT-020-5/scenarios/[cocu-name]-scenarios.md

Each file contains 2-3 scenarios with: industry context (50-75 words), complex problem statement, real-world constraints, success criteria, mapping to 3+ learning outcomes and Bloom's Create/Evaluate levels
Includes references to Malaysian regulations (fintech, cybersecurity, data protection) or industry bodies where applicable

stories.title: Analyze Practical Exercise Prerequisites and Sequencing Recommendations
stories.description: Map dependencies between practical exercises across all CoCus to identify prerequisite skills, skill-building sequences, and opportunities for parallel lab work. Generate dependency graph enabling instructors to plan efficient lab timetables.
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts all practical exercises from all 20 CoCu files; identifies required skills/tools per exercise (parse exercise descriptions)
Builds directed graph where edge A→B means exercise A prerequisite for B; detects cycles, orphans, and disjoint subgraphs
Outputs output/exercise_prerequisites.json with {exercises: [{name, cocu, required_skills: [], depends_on: [], can_parallel_with: []}]}; validates acyclic DAG structure

stories.title: Detect and Flag Content Duplication Within and Across CoCu Levels
stories.description: Scan all 20 CoCus for duplicate/near-duplicate learning outcomes, work activities, and content sections using semantic similarity. Identify redundancy across L3/L4/L5 progression to flag potential merge opportunities and skill integration points.
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts learning outcomes, work activities, key terms from all 20 files; calculates pairwise semantic similarity using sentence-transformers
Flags pairs with ≥0.85 similarity; groups by CoCu level to show L3-L4-L5 duplication patterns; confidence scores >0.90 marked for immediate review
Outputs output/duplication_report.json with {duplicates: [{outcome_text_1, outcome_text_2, similarity_score, cocu_pair, merge_recommendation: 'consolidate'|'distinguish'}]}

stories.title: Enrich Work Activity Descriptions with Real-World Malaysian IT Context
stories.description: For each work activity in NOSS header tables, generate contextual narrative (5-10 sentences) explaining why the competency matters in actual Malaysian IT workplaces. Reference current industry challenges, regulatory frameworks, employer expectations, and salary/demand metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses all 20 CoCu files; extracts work activity descriptions from NOSS header tables (regex pattern matching)

For each activity, generates realistic context narrative incorporating: Malaysian IT workplace scenario, industry standard reference (SIRIM/BNM/ISCO-08), regulatory context (if applicable), typical salary range, and labor market demand
Inserts as markdown section 'Work Activity Context' immediately after NOSS header table in each file; validates no >250-word narratives (readability)

stories.title: Generate Student Self-Assessment Mastery Checklist Workbook
stories.description: Create interactive Excel workbook enabling students to self-assess progress toward mastery of every learning outcome. Include practice resource links, mastery thresholds aligned to rubrics, and instructor sign-off checkpoints for formative feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses all 20 CoCus; generates Excel workbook output/student_mastery_checklists.xlsx with one tab per CoCu

Each outcome has columns: (1) outcome description, (2) self-checkbox 'I can demonstrate this', (3) evidence link (e.g., assignment/portfolio), (4) instructor sign-off with date, (5) confidence rating 1-5
Adds conditional formatting: red if no self-assessment, yellow if self-assessed but no instructor sign-off, green if complete; calculates % mastery per student per CoCu
